$comment: Written by /shape-project; edited only by the owner, between runs (loop sessions cannot change it). Items point at docs instead of copying acceptance criteria. An item that adds or changes what a user types has "type": "command": the reviewer then scores it on the CLI rubric and its milestone is accepted on the installed package. LOOP-0 proves the pipeline end to end before any real work.

items.title: Prove the pipeline end to end on a harmless change
items.scope: A harmless change that exercises every gate once: record the next free decision ID in docs/DECISIONS.md (row and log bullet: the pipeline was proven end to end by LOOP-0), and make sure AC-0.1 has a passing test whose title carries the ID. Open a PR to the base branch, let the local gate, CI, review, merge, landed check and base CI run. Change nothing under loop/, .github/ or .claude/.
